issues.message: Block starts with a bare digit directly touching the next character. PaddleOCR-VL inconsistently merges the left-margin problem-number glyph into the stem text instead of keeping it as a separate block (verified: "1" + "4 이하의..." -> "14 이하의..."). This may be a real leading digit or a merged problem number; not auto-corrected.
